Name: Pashur, Father of Jeroham
Summary: Father of Jeroham in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Malchijah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Jeroham in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Malchijah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Pashur in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
